pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 60 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1300 °C·d$(). Best near 31 °C; stops above 42 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -1 °C (0 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5.8-7.5 (tolerates 5-8.5). Roots 1.5 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 120, P 25, K 120 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 64 bu/ac (4 t/ha).
$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Sorghum Head and Sorghum Seeds. Grows two blocks tall.
